mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% indicates severe labor market deterioration, triggering a negative market reaction as recession risks increase, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) from the prior month signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. The interaction is necessary because the combined effect is stronger than either indicator alone.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change above 4.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90.0 (indicating a severe supply-side contraction) signals an impending recession, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by non-farm payrolls above 130,000 thousand persons, leads to higher consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. This is an always-on signal.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending, indicated by retail sales above 380,000 thousand dollars, signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. This signal is active in a strong consumer spending regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 380000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days. This signal is active during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% over a 3-year rolling window.
